subject: WSJ - Enron Price Target @ $9 !!
before_rationale: External article links CFO transaction inquiry and opaque financial structure to sparse disclosure; peripheral disclosure lead.
after_rationale: The article focuses on valuation, acquisition speculation and liquidity. It briefly mentions a CFO-related SEC inquiry, but supplies no transaction terms, retained obligation, or details of the filings under scrutiny.

subject: RE: Enron Corp. Exposure - ETS
before_rationale: Consolidated Enron support listing and downgrade protections concern parent guarantees and financing exposure.
after_rationale: The email forwards a general ETS exposure inventory and asks about credit support on downgrade. The only identified guarantee concerns Mavrix, a wholly owned pipeline-capacity trading affiliate. The available text does not tie the support inventory to a target financing arrangement.

subject: new power
before_rationale: Specific New Power collateral release includes receivable advance rates, covenants and severance restrictions.
after_rationale: Discusses replacing cash margin with eligible receivables and other collateral under the bilateral New Power master agreement. New Power also appears in Raptor records, but the collateral amendment identified here is separate from the Raptor warrants and hedge.

subject: ERMT LLC Contribution Agreements
before_rationale: ERMT operating company capitalization and licensing contributions are specified. The email does not describe use of the interests for an SPE hedge, risk transfer or related accounting.
after_rationale: The contribution agreements trace $350 million and fourteen Chiricahua LLC interests into ERMT. Related internal records identify ERMT as part of the Swapco structure and describe proposed weather-swap assignments to two of the LLCs with parent guarantees and a planned return of the positions to ENA.

subject: RE: meeting
before_rationale: Identifies JEDI in a search for a Costilla lawsuit. Awaiting a pleading and confirming an entity name provides no link between the dispute and the target financing conduct.
after_rationale: Identifies the Harris County Costilla pleading involving JEDI. The related stay correspondence connects it to the Zapata County case, which contemporaneous reporting links to a JEDI financing dispute and an investment loss Enron said it did not separately identify in SEC filings.
